paralogues.name: Diversionary Tactics
paralogues.note: Battle is fixed to 9/8. You must talk to Leda by 9/7 at the latest — you cannot skip forward to 9/8 yourself. Simplest paralogue; watch poison.

paralogues.name: Missing Brave-Warrior Statue
paralogues.note: Fog of war. Stand on 3 mechanisms (SE, SW, NW). Dietrich-only.

paralogues.name: Friendly Match with Brigid's King
paralogues.note: Kill 4 Giants before Peppe's group. Battle starts 9pm the day you accept. Needed for Peppe (Cai/Die/The) and Gaitz (Die).

paralogues.name: Secret of the Vanished Carriage
paralogues.note: Thieves grab cargo and run for the top exit — keep a fast unit back. Needed for Ursula.

die.flag: Ch9 free time ends 9/19, so the first window is really 9/17–9/19; Ch10 is 9/29–10/4.

paralogues.name: Golden Secret
paralogues.note: Small deployment; bring Physic + anti-armor. Don't let Solel fight the Giant; break the last ore deposit to stun it.

die.flag: Do it ASAP — Ch10 free time is only 9/29–10/4.

paralogues.name: Queen of the Erased
paralogues.reward: Electron Agitator (+Spellshard & Dew of Peace if all villagers live)
paralogues.note: Hardest paralogue (Pentkehydra). You don't need to kill the boss. Escort villagers E then N counter-clockwise. Needed for Sha Lan.

paralogues.name: Great Escape
paralogues.note: Battle is fixed to 10/22 in Dagsion — talk to Cai by 10/21 at the latest. Beeline Centurio. Needed for Tialla.

the.flag: Do this LAST in Ch12 (fixed 10/22 date eats your turns).

paralogues.name: Sealed-Off Past
paralogues.note: 10-turn defense. Archers on the E side for Pegasus Knights. Needed for Fabio (Leda).

the.flag: Quest page says 11/1 but Theodora's Part I ends 10/24.

leda.flag: Sources disagree on pickup end: 10/22 (paralogue guide) vs 10/29 (Leda walkthrough). Grab it by 10/22 to be safe.

paralogues.name: Orchel's Regret
paralogues.note: Biggest map. Split up, hit both switches together to fire the Onager. Pegasus reinforcements E. Chests are just Pure Water. Needed for Diego on every route.

cai.flag: Only 3 pickup days on Cai's route.

the.flag: Quest page says 10/27 but Theodora's Part I ends 10/24.

recruits.tip: Giant's Meat: one always in Sand-Shadow Fort, or Giant-icon skirmishes.

leda: Dietrich's Paralogue + Dietrich's team eliminated (~Ch12) + suitable item (a Da Mina weapon works)

recruits.tip: Paradise Fish: Lake Brontes (Saveilon), past Valhalla Mine.
recruits.conflict: Leda: RPG Site says 6R, KeenGamer says 8R.

recruits.tip: Glirmosa: Mount Orgus Trail, Rear Mountain Path, Forest of No Return, Giant's Mount (Pasithea).

die: Anatolia's Paralogue; answer Saramis, Da Mina, Grounded Ship
leda: Anatolia's Paralogue; answer Saramis, Da Mina, Grounded Ship

recruits.conflict: Cai: RPG Site says 9R, KeenGamer says 5R.

the.t: Send Supplies quests (Theodora-only) all expire 10/24, the very last day of her route.
the.s: Ch8 Ladon Loach ×35 → Cataphract class. Ch9 Kothar Gar ×10 → Guardian. Ch11 Sea-Star Stone ×35 → Dragoon.

the.t: Special Match: Exhibition vs Bertrand on 4/6 at 18:00, path between Temple Row and Hightown.
the.s: Theodora-exclusive. You only need to damage him, not kill him.

the.t: Optional scene: talk to Alexandra in City Streets, then the pulsing event in Lowtown.
the.s: Scenes are tracked at the Obelisk Chamber pedestal.

the.t: Enno Isle (lv 24) dungeon is Theodora-exclusive — ship required.
the.s: Good chapter to sail the Danann Sea; Carna Bonito for Send Supplies is at Peluza Cape.

the.t: Theater unlocks at Renown 7, Thermae at Renown 8 (all routes).
the.s: Both raise support — Stage Shows count toward recruitment.

the.t: Lend Anatolia your ship (she asks, returns it by 9/21).
the.s: Her team then fights alongside you in the Ch12 finale, plus an extra Anatolia scene in Ch11.

the.t: Optional scene with Orchel in Yu Phas' Temple (via Entertainment District).
the.s: Northern Passage also has a new chest this chapter: Phantom Ring.

the.t: Before the Talimun main match, 'hear Lilian out' for support.
Anatolia's team is NOT in Dagsion during Ch12. Recruit Nezha / Dadao / Halvin in Ch11 or lose them.
the.s: Wait until they return with your boat if you lent it. Sha Lan isn't recruitable on Theodora.

the.t: Ch12 free time is only 32 turns (10/16–10/24) with three paralogues in it. Front-load everything into Ch11.
the.s: Great Escape is fixed to 10/22 — do it last. Sealed-Off Past and Orchel's Regret both die at 10/24 no matter what the quest page says.

the.t: Last chance to recruit anyone on this route.
the.s: Theodora-only recruits: Bonaventure, Tobias (auto). Lilian & Lysander are auto here but cost 7–8R elsewhere.

cai.t: Choose 'Pursue' after the Event Clash for the Galen Fort Ruins tutorial dungeon (Hunter's Bow inside).
cai.s: Optional scene with Castor/Centurio to the east in Dagsion before doing anything else.

cai.t: Optional scene: Bertrand in the jail (Cai gains Sword EXP).
Mentorships (Cai-only): Castor 'Terrain Tips' → Bolt Gem; Aurora at 4R 'Staying Healthy' → Healing Staff.
cai.s: Stables/Lure/Farming are Cai-exclusive. Animal bonds give class-relevant stat skills (e.g. Wild Horse lv5 bond → Paired Run+).

cai.t: Optional scene at the mural in Ahm Lu before the main marker.
cai.s: Mentorships: Bertrand 5R 'Know Your Enemy' → Halberd; Centurio 6R 'Against Large Foes' → Levin Sword.

cai.t: Kindness quest 'The Artisans of Megaira' → unlocks carriages (much faster travel). Do it ASAP.
cai.s: 'Trouble at the Gate' opens Hugo Stronghold to reach Castalia. Castor 7R mentorship (2× Angelica) → Caladrius class.

cai.t: Aurora 8R mentorship 'Special Request from Mom' → Dragoon class.
cai.s: 'Beasts Blocking the Path Home' opens Idyia. Start catching a Wild Pegasus for a Ch11 quest.

cai.t: Ultand is unavailable this chapter (back in Ch10). Very short free time 9/3–9/11.
Orchel's Regret pickup is only 10/18–10/20 on Cai's route, deadline 10/21.
cai.s: Cai's Ch11 is 10/16–10/23; nothing else paralogue-wise lands here.

cai.t: Ch12 (11/4–11/27) has no paralogues — pure cleanup and recruiting.
cai.s: Most Kindness quests run to 11/27. Highest-level Part I dungeon is on the southern continent (Ogmios).

die.t: Optional scene with Talimun (south pulse on the map) after the Tavern — unlocks a second Event Clash that night.
die.s: Also: Esmeralda at the Inn; Mikaela & Esmeralda by the Arena → Mikaela/Mu scene in the shops.

die.t: Blacksmith class needs 10 Combat Arts upgraded at Smyrnos's Temple (~400 Magic Echo Shards).
die.s: Use Answerer's Cry regularly on the world map to farm shards. Dietrich-only.

die.t: Optional scene: talk to Fabio, then the scene in the eastern alleys.
die.s: This is a prerequisite for a Ch10 Fabio scene (18:00 near Temple Rows).

die.t: Dread Warrior Challenges (Dietrich-only duels) gate on Renown and all end 11/27.
die.s: Il-Lara (Ch8) → Guardian class. Oko (Ch10) → Ranger class.

die.t: Optional scene: Alexandra in City Streets → Lowtown event.
Optional scene at 18:00 in the Lowtown alley (comes with an Event Clash).
die.s: Cetus hunt 7/21–7/31: clear Uncharted Isle (east) first, then fail-search Pasha Currents, Wandering Whirlpool, Eif Channel before Sea of Screams. Nod to Fabio afterward for support.

die.t: Bertrand's Paralogue is available on 9/17 ONLY. Shortest window in the game.
die.s: If you do it 9/17 you can still just reach Talimun's before free time ends 9/19; otherwise Talimun's persists into Ch10/11.

die.t: Free time is only 9/29–10/4. Do Anna's Paralogue immediately.
die.s: Inquire Fabio in the opening scenes for support. Fabio 18:00 scene near Temple Rows if you saw the Ch5 one.

die.t: Three paralogues here (Anatolia's, Cai's, Orchel's) — the long 10/5–11/3 free time makes this Dietrich's big paralogue chapter.
Gaitz becomes recruitable once Bertrand's team is out of the tournament (~Ch12). Needs 3S/10R + Bertrand's Paralogue.
die.s: Optional scene with Fabio in the alley east of the markets. No paralogues in Ch12.

leda.t: Optional scenes: Mikaela in the shopping area; Talimun in the shopping area (not on the very first turn of free time).
leda.s: Perform Quests (Leda-only) pay huge Renown — do every one.

leda.t: Drink-recipe chain: Simple (3R) → Captains' (6R) → Popular (8R) → Elegant (10R, ends 11/17!) → Song of Angels + Ranger & Troubadour classes.
leda.s: Leaves come from Perform quests: Sweet (Ch4–6), Pepper (Ch7+), Bitter (Ch10), Wonder (Ch11).

leda.t: Leda-only subquest 'Monster in the Night' — eastern alleys after 18:00, ends 5/7.
leda.s: Optional scene with Kalla at her shrine.

leda.t: Optional scenes: Olympia in Temple Row; Alexandra in City Streets → Lowtown.
Leda-only subquest 'Learning More about Mehdel' from Sirocco, ends 6/28.
18:00 scene with Sirocco in Temple Row, then follow him toward Hightown for a second scene.
leda.s: 'Great Dancer's Successor' (Hingosh from Baina Oasis) → Dancer's Necklace, ends 10/15.

leda.t: Leda's story skips 9/2–9/27 entirely. Finish everything ending 9/1 and 10/15 during this long free time.
leda.s: Leda has no paralogues in September, so nothing is lost there.

leda.t: Lv 30 Trial Battle at Kalla's Main Temple → Kalla's Bow (Leda-only).
leda.s: Anna's shop starts appearing north of Temple Row.

leda.t: Fabio becomes recruitable once Dietrich's team is eliminated (~Ch12). Needs Dietrich's Paralogue (grab it 10/16–10/22) + 3S/9R + a Da Mina weapon.
leda.s: Three paralogues in Ch11 (Cai's, Dietrich's, Orchel's).

leda.t: Ch12 (11/7–11/27) has no paralogues — cleanup and recruiting only.

all.t: Support levels are GLOBAL and never go down. Hit 3S with someone once and it counts on every route — so the real per-route cost is Renown + the extra item/quest.
all.s: Bless levels are global too. Subquests done on one route auto-complete (and pay out) on others.

all.t: Leda's (9/8) and Cai's (10/22) paralogues have fixed battle days. Accept them at least the day before; you can't manually skip to the date.
Watch shrine icons in Temple Row turning yellow — a free audience with a god gives Renown and costs no turn.
all.s: Feeding the Pale Raven, praying, Arena training and Inn meals are also free actions.

all.t: Creek (Part II) requires the Part I subquest 'My Late Sister's Accessory'. Subquests are semi-random per route, so keep an eye out on every path.
all.s: Nathan (Part II Ch3) then requires Creek to land the killing blow on him.

all.t: Bertrand, Talimun, Anatolia and Orchel only become full Part III units if you cleared their paralogue somewhere in Part I.
all.s: A Flame Lord whose paralogue you cleared but whose route you never finished is a 'limited' Part III ally — irrelevant if you do all four routes.

all.t: Anna's shop appears north of Temple Row from Ch10 with rotating rare stock.
